controls.name: label_permutation
controls.purpose: destroy alignment between recovery labels and features
controls.invalid_if: permuted labels retain the same ranking

controls.name: topology_destroyed
controls.invalid_if: destroyed topology still produces the same metric ordering

control_policy: controls must use the same execution path as the target
controls must be frozen before runner implementation
controls must fail honestly if they destroy the intended structure
controls must not be redefined after holdout inspection
